we measured the pressure dependent refractive indices of Ar, He, Ne, Kr, Xe, N(2) and their mixtures in the wavelength range from 0.2 to 1.6 micrometers.

the dispersion of gases and mixtures can be accurately described by a simple two-term formula with the coefficients depending on the gas composition.
